description: The comment on parse_header_property says 'Caller has already confirmed...len > 7', but the caller checks p.starts_with("header:") and p.len() > 7. The string "header:" is exactly 7 bytes, so len > 7 implies at least one character after the prefix — the comment says '>7' where it should say '>= 8' (or the check should be p.len() > 7). An implementor relying on the comment to understand the precondition will misread the invariant.
title: parse_header_property caller-invariant comment is incorrect
